name: Mothers Working Outside The Home
overview: Scripture highlights the influential role of mothers in shaping their families and instructing future generations, as seen in Proverbs 31:1 where a mother imparts wisdom to her son, King Lemuel. Titus 2:4-5 emphasizes that women are called to be sober, loving toward their husbands and children, and discreet, with a strong focus on being keepers at home. This teaching underscores the importance of a mother’s presence and faithfulness within the household, ensuring that their conduct honors God and upholds His Word.
